checks.claim: The PCE base rate, set at 19.35 cents/kWh
checks.evidence: Regulatory Commission of Alaska notice dated May 2, 2025 (docket U-25-010) states the current base amount is 19.92 cents per kWh, so 19.35 was an earlier base. A notice dated May 1, 2026 (docket U-26-010) proposes raising the base amount to 22.11 cents/kWh; that is a proposal, not an order. A FY2026 figure of 20.38 appears in a search summary only and is not fetched.

checks.review: Overruled (main session): the claim is a clause of a sentence that continues 'in 2023, was 20.38 cents/kWh in 2026 (22.11 proposed for FY2027)', cited to the U-26-010 notice. 19.35 is correctly dated as the 2023 rate; 19.92 is an intermediate FY2026 base the sentence does not need.
